items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the house band was Art Blakey, Kenny Drew, and Eugene Wright... we became a bona fide traveling group

ctx.x: And that became a really important collaboration.

I had a job at the Birdland, you know, as a soloist. And the house band was Art Blakey, Kenny Drew, and Eugene Wright. And from the first note we gelled, it was picnic, everybody liked it and we, and by the end of that engagement, I think it was two weeks I had Birdland, I said to Art, “Lets make a group out of this and go out.” And Art said, “Yeah, lets do it.” So we did, we became a bona fide traveling group. And did well most of the time.
Known as the “Buddy DeFranco Quartet.” Right…
